title: Under COMMA_SEPARATED an array loses an element, not just a distinction
rationale: The Javadoc documents that empty string and null are indistinguishable in delimited formats - an accepted, stated loss. What is NOT documented is that the array also changes LENGTH: splitRespectingBrackets only emits a trailing segment when the buffer is non-empty, so a final empty field is dropped entirely.
catchesBugClass: Silent arity loss in delimited round trips, and specifically the trailing-empty-field bug that a leading or interior empty field would not reveal.
cannotCatch: Cannot separate the accepted half from the defective half automatically. It also does not test two consecutive trailing empties or an all-empty array, and says nothing about PIPE_SEPARATED.

predicted.detail: Two separate failures: empty-string-to-null (accepted and documented) and three elements becoming two (undocumented, and the reason this is DEFECT rather than ACCEPTED_LOSS).
